intro: Q3 2026 BUY regime formally activated: NFP Goldilocks (~119K July 2) + SPX/VIX dual gate confirmation (July 1 close) = the structural AI thesis has been validated by macro regime simultaneously for the first time since the May 14 ATH. Long-term framework update: three independent data points in the past week confirm the AI infrastructure super-cycle is intact (Micron $50B Q4 FY26 guide, Samsung $226B AI data center commitment, NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra 1.5x H100 performance shipping). The Korea circuit breaker session (July 2: KOSPI -4.45%, SK Hynix -10.96%) on the Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM narrative is the first significant near-term threat to the Korean memory sector thesis — but the distinction between mobile DRAM (smartphones, affected) and HBM4 (AI data centers, unaffected) is the critical analytical separator. Warsh FOMC hawkish hold (no cuts through 2026–2027) remains the primary discount-rate headwind for long-duration growth assets. SK Hynix conviction LOWERED to LOW from MEDIUM pending Stop Day 2 determination and mobile DRAM supply chain reassessment. All other long-term theses remain at prior conviction levels with the Q3 BUY regime upgrade as the macro tailwind.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.idea: NVDA is the dominant structural AI infrastructure pick and conviction is UNCHANGED at HIGH despite the July 2 selloff to $197.58. The mandatory exit at $193.85 (June 29, Stop Day 2) was risk management discipline, not a fundamental thesis change. The July 1 BUY re-entry (triple gate confirmed at $200.09 close) initiated a half-size position; full-size add pending July 7 open gate confirmation. The Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM story is categorically irrelevant to NVDA: CXMT makes smartphone DRAM, not HBM4 for AI data centers. Blackwell Ultra (GB300 NVL72 = 1.5x GB200 performance) is shipping; sovereign AI capex ($100B+ from EU, Japan, Saudi Arabia, UAE) is confirmed at heads-of-state level; HBM memory supply chain locked in with SK Hynix/Micron through H2 2026. Q2 FY27 earnings (est. August 26, ~$91B quarterly revenue guide) is the structural re-entry confirmation event.
ideas.why: Every major AI model training and inference deployment runs on NVIDIA hardware. Switching cost is 18–24 months of software re-optimization — AMD and Intel cannot close this gap in FY27. MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META are all committed to multi-year NVDA GPU purchases confirmed in Q1 2026 earnings calls. Blackwell's revenue opportunity per AI factory is 50x greater than Hopper — the platform transition creates a structural ASP uplift compounding through FY26–FY27. The $195 supply overhang (June 29 stop exit) was tactical profit-taking from the May 14 ATH cycle; the fundamental AI infrastructure demand is structural and confirmed by three independent data points in the past week alone.
ideas.driver: Blackwell B300 GPU ramp (H2 2026) expanding compute density 3x vs H100; sovereign AI capex from EU, Japan, Saudi Arabia, UAE confirmed at $100B+ combined; inference demand scaling faster than training as AI moves from development to deployment phase; Q2 FY27 earnings August 26 confirming >$91B quarterly guide; Rubin architecture roadmap (2027 successor) extending competitive moat
ideas.risk: US export controls tighten restricting H20/B20 sales to China (removes ~$10–15B annual revenue); AMD MI400 achieves competitive performance within 12 months; hyperscaler capex cuts in H1 2027 if AI monetization disappoints investors; FOMC rate hold through 2027 compresses long-duration multiple from current ~35x forward; NVDA July 7 full-size add fails to trigger (Gate 3 below $200 for second time)

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.idea: MU is the most compelling near-term AI semi structural buy and conviction is UPGRADED TO HIGH on the Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM story. The CXMT/YMTC narrative is a Micron positive: every mobile DRAM market share point Apple gives to Chinese suppliers (CXMT) is a signal that US government AI procurement must use US-manufactured memory — Micron's Idaho HBM4 fab advantage is AMPLIFIED, not threatened. Q3 FY26 +15.7% earnings beat, HBM4 sold out through 2026, $50B Q4 FY26 guide (~40% above prior consensus). No forced-exit overhang. No ADR mechanics. Cleanest technical and fundamental setup of any AI semi.
ideas.why: Pentagon 1260H blacklist status for CXMT and YMTC means US government AI procurement cannot use Chinese DRAM — by extension, US-manufactured Micron HBM4 from Idaho is the only DoD-compliant HBM4 supplier. Samsung's $226B AI data center commitment validated Micron's $50B Q4 guide at national-government scale. The HBM market is a structural oligopoly: three players (Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron) with pricing discipline enforced by technological complexity. CHIPS Act incentives reducing MU's per-wafer cost at scale. Apple/CXMT narrative makes MU MORE strategically defensible for US institutional investors, not less.
ideas.driver: HBM4 ramp through H2 2026 — $50B Q4 FY26 guide sets FY27 at $200B+ revenue run rate; CHIPS Act Idaho fab incentives reducing HBM4 production cost; DoD AI procurement mandate for US-manufactured HBM (amplified by Apple/CXMT/YMTC Pentagon blacklist context); September Q4 FY26 earnings confirmation of HBM demand cycle duration; pricing discipline in oligopolistic 3-player HBM market
ideas.risk: HBM demand cycle peaks in H1 2027 earlier than expected as AI model efficiency improvements reduce memory per compute unit; Samsung or SK Hynix aggressive pricing to defend market share; Q4 FY26 guide miss at September earnings (the single largest downside risk given the $50B expectation); China export controls remove DRAM export channel

ideas.name: SK Hynix
ideas.timeframe: 3–9 months (post-stop determination + post-ADR seasoning + Q3 2026 earnings)
ideas.idea: SK Hynix conviction LOWERED TO LOW from MEDIUM. Stop Day 1 triggered on July 2 KST close (₩2,301,000, -10.96%): first close-based mandatory stop breach since position initiated. The stop protocol requires TWO consecutive KST closes below ₩2,540,000 for mandatory full exit — July 3 KST session determines whether Stop Day 2 triggers mandatory exit at July 6 KST open. LONG-TERM STRUCTURAL REASSESSMENT: Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM story introduces the first credible narrative of Samsung/SK Hynix mobile DRAM market share erosion. Mobile DRAM is ~30% of SK Hynix revenue — meaningful but not dominant relative to HBM4. IF stop protocol forces mandatory exit: re-entry framework requires ADR listing (July 10 SKHY) stabilization + KOSPI reclear 8,500 + SK Hynix reclear ₩2,700,000 + mobile DRAM competitive assessment.
ideas.why: SK Hynix HBM4 structural thesis is UNCHANGED: world's largest HBM3e/HBM4 supplier, NVIDIA Blackwell B300 exclusive partner for AI data centers. Apple's CXMT/YMTC negotiation is for China-market smartphone mobile DRAM and NAND — a categorically different product from the HBM4 that drives SK Hynix's 60%+ HBM market share and AI data center revenue. The conviction reduction is driven by (1) stop protocol breach on a closing basis (risk management discipline override), (2) KOSPI circuit breaker session (7,934, -4.45%) confirming broader Korean macro fragility (CPI 3.2% highest since Dec 2023), and (3) ADR underwriter floor drift (₩2,541,000 June 30 → ₩2,258,000 July 2) indicating protective bid is declining. The structural ADR catalyst (July 10 SKHY listing, MSCI index inclusion process) is unchanged.
ideas.driver: July 10 Nasdaq ADR listing (SKHY, $29.4B) — post-listing MSCI World index inclusion process; HBM4 ramp as primary NVIDIA Blackwell B300 supplier; Q3 2026 earnings (August) confirming HBM4 ASP premium over HBM3e; KOSPI ADR-listing-driven institutional reallocation; post-stop re-entry (if triggered) at confirmed support above ₩2,700,000
ideas.risk: Stop Day 2 triggers July 3 KST: mandatory exit 4 sessions before the primary structural catalyst (ADR listing July 10); Apple/CXMT/YMTC narrative creates multi-quarter mobile DRAM ASP compression even if HBM4 is unaffected; KOSPI macro deterioration (CPI 3.2% → BOK hawkish hold → KRW weakness) persists through H2 2026; ADR underwriter floor drift continues to ₩2,000,000+ decline, breaking the structural backstop; NVDA supply diversification toward Samsung if HBM4 yield improves

ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.idea: Microsoft is the most diversified AI monetization play with the strongest rate resilience: Azure AI cloud (OpenAI partnership exclusive enterprise deployment), Copilot productivity suite (365 seats at $30/month premium), GitHub Copilot (developer workflow capture). FOMC Warsh hawkish hold through 2027–2028 pressures growth multiples but MSFT's $100B+ FCF and ~2% dividend yield provide a floor that pure-growth AI names lack. Q3 BUY regime upgrade confirms the enterprise AI adoption tailwind — Copilot seat expansion is the primary revenue driver in 2026.
ideas.why: Enterprise AI adoption in 2026 is about Copilot seat expansion, not new product launches. 400M+ commercial 365 seats converting at 10–20% to Copilot Premium at $30/month = 2.5x revenue per seat vs. base tier. Azure AI workloads are sticky: switching cost is 12–24 months of enterprise IT re-integration. Goldilocks NFP + US BUY regime = IT budget cycle continues expanding through FY27. Each Fortune 500 company's AI pipeline running on Azure fine-tuning with OpenAI exclusivity creates a 3–5 year switching friction moat.
ideas.driver: Copilot monetization at scale — 400M+ 365 commercial seats with 10–20% penetration to Copilot Premium; Azure AI revenue compounding at 35%+ YoY through FY27; GitHub Copilot Enterprise expansion; sovereign AI infrastructure licensing (EU, Middle East); $100B FCF floor providing rate-resilient valuation support
ideas.risk: OpenAI explores independent cloud or direct enterprise relationships (partnership deteriorates); Google Gemini captures enterprise AI at lower price point; FOMC rate hold through 2028 compresses MSFT multiple from 32x forward to 25x; EU AI Act compliance costs ($2–5B one-time)

ideas.name: Meta Platforms
ideas.idea: META has the most direct AI-to-revenue conversion path of any big-tech name and conviction is MAINTAINED at HIGH on the Q3 BUY regime upgrade. No semiconductor supply chain exposure to the Korea shock. Goldilocks NFP confirms the US consumer employment backdrop for ad spend. AI ad targeting improvements compound instantaneously across 3.3B daily active users — every 1% CPM improvement translates directly to revenue without enterprise sales cycles. LLaMA 4 open-source flywheel creates developer ecosystem lock-in. Q2 2026 earnings (late July) will be the first full-AI-feature quarter at scale — setup for 'beat and raise.'
ideas.why: 3.3B daily active users is an unassailable data and distribution moat for AI training and deployment. META's Zuckerberg AI personal assistant is the first consumer AI product with genuine distribution at scale — every new AI feature reaches 3.3B users in real-time. The monetization feedback loop has zero lag. EU AI Act compliance is a cost ($2–3B one-time), not an existential risk. META's FCF generation ($60B+ annual) makes it the most rate-resistant large-cap AI name in a Warsh hawkish hold environment through 2027–2028. Goldilocks NFP + US BUY regime = sustained consumer ad spend for the next 8–12 weeks through Q2 earnings.
ideas.driver: AI ad efficiency compounding — CPM expansion from AI targeting at 3.3B scale; LLaMA 4 ecosystem lock-in monetized through Meta AI products; AR glasses (Ray-Ban Meta) transitioning as AI assistant integration deepens; Q2 2026 earnings (late July) confirming AI monetization at scale; FCF $60B+ providing rate-resilient valuation floor
ideas.risk: Apple iOS ATT 3.0 (hypothetical) restricts cross-app tracking further; EU AI Act creates discriminatory compliance burden above $3B; ad recession in H2 2026 if employment deteriorates (not the Goldilocks scenario); AI Reality Labs losses exceed $20B/year offsetting core FCF

ideas.name: Bitcoin
ideas.idea: Bitcoin's April 2024 halving creates the supply shock that historically precedes a 12–18 month bull cycle peak. Post-halving cycle target: $90,000–$120,000 by mid-2027. IBIT institutionalized spot demand. The tactical posture is flat/cash pending TWO consecutive UTC midnight closes above $62,000 AND IBIT inflow confirmation — but the structural thesis is the most constructive it has been in 12 sessions: BTC at $61,324 with Goldilocks NFP just confirmed and the first Gate 1 test ($62,000) in reach. CONVICTION maintained at MEDIUM: structural bull unchanged; tactical flat until two-gate sequence confirmed.
ideas.why: Halving math: miner daily sell pressure permanently reduced ~450 BTC/day. IBIT institutionalized demand that didn't exist in prior halvings — $4.5B in June outflows represents the first institutional clean-out before re-accumulation. US crypto regulatory clarity (2026 SEC under new leadership) legitimizing the asset class. Goldilocks NFP + US BUY regime upgrade is the most constructive macro backdrop for BTC since the April 2024 halving. At $61,324 in still-elevated Fear with a post-halving supply shock and US equity regime clearing, the medium-term risk/reward remains asymmetric. IBIT flow reversal is the leading indicator for the next leg — watch July 2–3 UTC midnight closes as the Gate 1/2 confirmation sequence.
ideas.driver: Post-halving supply shock fully pricing in through Q3–Q4 2026; IBIT inflow resumption post-NFP resolution (two-gate sequence July 2–3 UTC midnight closes); US crypto regulatory clarity (SEC formal spot ETF framework for ETH and SOL); Goldilocks NFP + US BUY regime upgrade most constructive macro backdrop in 12 sessions; El Salvador, Bhutan, UAE sovereign adoption expanding institutional base
ideas.risk: July 2 UTC midnight close fails Gate 1 ($62,000) despite Goldilocks NFP — momentum reversal risk; IBIT sustained outflows continue through July 7 (no institutional demand signal); US Congress adverse crypto legislation (unfavorable tax treatment or leverage restrictions); Korea-shock crypto contagion (crypto markets never close — holiday gap creates 24/7 risk); BTC fails both UTC midnight closes in the July 2–3 window

ideas.name: SpaceX
ideas.timeframe: 3–12 months (through Nasdaq 100 inclusion, September 2 earnings, and SpaceX IPO optionality)
ideas.idea: SPCX carries the most binary structural optionality in the portfolio. The step-aside tactical posture is UNCHANGED at HIGH conviction (bond distribution Day 8, volume ~52M, clearance est. July 9–11, re-entry gate $185). The long-term thesis is structurally intact: September 2 first earnings (Starlink ARR, Starship revenue, Cursor AI $500M+) is the fundamental anchoring event; the $148–$170 accumulation window may be the 2026 entry zone if distribution clears and July 7 Nasdaq 100 inclusion provides the first systematic demand wave. Korea shock has NO direct impact on SpaceX fundamentals (Starlink, Starship, Cursor AI are domestic US revenue stories). SpaceX IPO optionality (rumored 2026–2027) makes SPCX the primary liquid retail vehicle for SpaceX exposure.
ideas.why: Space infrastructure is at the same inflection point cloud computing crossed in 2012–2014: cost curves have collapsed (Falcon 9 reuse 250+ flights, Starship development cost-to-orbit declining) but revenue generation is in its first commercial innings. Starlink is profitable. SpaceX DoD backlog is $10B+. At $157.98, SPCX is inside the $148–$170 base accumulation window first identified as the pre-September earnings zone. Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 ($4.3B passive) adds the first systematic index demand — but the step-aside discipline through distribution mechanics is the correct approach: re-entry at $185+ post-clearance captures the index tailwind with confirmed demand and without distribution supply overhang.
ideas.driver: Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7 (~$4.3B systematic inflows from QQQ/QQQM); bond distribution clearance est. July 9–11 (re-entry gate $185 activated post-clearance); SpaceX IPO optionality (2026–2027 rumored) creating retail demand for the only public SpaceX vehicle; September 2 first post-IPO earnings (Starlink ARR, Starship revenue recognition, Cursor AI $500M+ threshold); Starlink terminal adoption acceleration in emerging markets and DoD Starshield contracts
ideas.risk: December 9 lock-up expiry (180 days from June 12 IPO) — float expands from ~4% to 9–14%, creating structural supply ceiling before September 2 earnings anchor; Korea-shock-driven IG floor breach ($150) on July 6 open = framework reassessment required; Nasdaq 100 inclusion demand fully absorbed before re-entry gate activates (Russell 1000 June 26 template repeats); bond distribution second wave above $165 pushing back $185 gate timeline; SpaceX IPO delayed to 2028+ removing primary SPCX optionality catalyst
